items.question: Is the autumn 2026 level of cross-chain demand holding?
items.baseline: highest monthly mean of Dec 2025 to Aug 2026 (August 2026)
items.statement: NEAR Intents volume over the 7 days ending 2026-11-17 stays above the top of its range before the September step

items.question: Was the September step in cross-chain demand a new level or a spike?
items.baseline: highest monthly mean of Dec 2025 to Aug 2026 (August 2026)
items.statement: NEAR Intents volume in December 2026 stays above the top of its range before the September step; in December 2025 it fell back after a one-month spike

items.question: Does the money reaching the token hold its new level?
items.baseline: highest monthly buyback of Mar to Aug 2026 (August 2026)
items.statement: Buybacks funded by Intents revenue in December 2026 stay above their highest month before the September step

items.question: Do buybacks offset the dilution of holders?
items.baseline: half of net new supply; break-even is 1.0
items.statement: Over the 90 days ending 2027-02-11 buybacks still offset less than half of the net new NEAR supply

items.question: Can usage be used as a timing signal for the price?
items.statement: No usage metric shows two neighbouring positive leads outside the noise band: usage still does not lead price

items.question: Has the base of regular self-paying accounts found a floor?
items.baseline: their lowest month before the September step (August 2026)
items.statement: In January 2027 accounts that pay their own fees and act 10 to 999 times a month stay above their August 2026 low: the rebound holds

items.question: Is self-paid activity at a new level or was it a spike?
items.baseline: highest month of Dec 2025 to Aug 2026 (February 2026)
items.statement: Self-paid transactions outside the reward apps average above the top of their range before the September step over November 2026 to January 2027

items.question: Does the chain still depend on a few dozen accounts?
items.baseline: dozens rather than hundreds; 30 in October 2026
items.statement: In January 2027 fewer than a hundred accounts still send half of all transactions

items.question: Which is the larger half of the chain: reward apps or financial use?
items.baseline: the point where the two are equal; 43% vs 41% in October 2026
items.statement: In January 2027 reward and wallet apps still send more transactions than the exchange, Intents, token contracts and bridges together
